title: Implement selected owned rank-two MOVE28141 with literal monomial factors, a rank-aware cutoff and complete HOME restoration
body:
## Result
Implement actual selected owned MOVE28141, frames601->470, as a literal monomial/positive-rank-two/monomial service. The original f and all nine-slot spectators are retained; the actual guard is2f<=cutoff. The31-tape core and35-tape HOME wrapper restore their supplied owners/heads/private fields with complete O(fV+E) local bills and historical backing.

## Verification and limits
Exact source/phase bindings, author normal/optimized replays and faulty-guard/child/phase controls pass. A separate sparse CPU and original-frame arithmetic oracle execute30,838,694 transitions,6156 late HOME writes, and complete restoration. Valid typed entry and every numerical prefix remain promises; full lifetime/caller, faster tariff and all five assumptions remain open. No new kappa.

Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/literal-owned-rank-two-move

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; retain #6978, #7000 and #7426-#7430 source credits. Review is not blind/human or formal-kernel verification.
